name: login-02
title: Login 02
description: Two columns: the form on a sheet of paper, and where the photograph would be a hand-made cover on the desk (graph paper, a greeting, Stubby waving, a pinned note, stickers). The cover shows from 48rem of width. Paper on one side, desk on the other, so it works on either.
docs:
Installed the "Login 02" block into your components directory under blocks/login-02/.
Import it: import Login02Page from "<your components alias>/blocks/login-02/page"
Needs vee-validate@^5, vee-validate@^7, zod@^4: the CLI installs them (a project on an older major is upgraded).
